General FAQs

How is Havells BLDC fans different from other BLDC fans?

Havells BLDC fans are better than the other products in the market as Havells BLDC fans operate 30 W. At Boost mode, Havells BLDC fans operate at 380 RPM and 235 cmm, which is one of the best in the market. In premium range BLDC fans Havells fan has unique USP such as All weather, MFD blades and underlight fans. All the BLDC fans are operated with RF remote, which provides a seamless operation in controlling the fans.

What are the benefits of ABS Blades over conventional blades?

ABS Blades in Havells fans provide you with better Air delivery when compared to the conventional Aluminum blades. Additionally, ABS Blades provide a noiseless operation which creates a peaceful experience. Stealth Air BLDC, Stealth Slim, Neoma are such fans with ABS blades of Havells fan.

Are BLDC ceiling fans better than conventional fans?

Yes. BLDC (Brushless Direct Current) ceiling fans are more energy-efficient, quieter, and longer-lasting than conventional fans. They consume up to 60% less electricity while delivering powerful airflow, helping reduce energy bills without compromising performance. Havells BLDC ceiling fans also offer convenient features such as remote control, timer functions, and smart connectivity in select models. With their silent operation, sleek designs, and low maintenance, Havells BLDC fans are an excellent choice for modern homes seeking comfort, efficiency, and style.

What are the unique premium range offerings by Havells fan?

Havells Fans has a unique premium range fans that offer features such as Underlight, Room heater, ABS Blades, MFD Blades, unique designs, Etc.

Is Havells fans are Made in India?

Yes, Havells Fan are made in Made in India. All the Ceiling fans are made at Haridwar, India.

Can ceiling-mounted fans be used in bathrooms or damp spaces?

Yes, Havells ceiling-mounted fans can be an excellent choice for bathrooms, utility rooms, laundry areas, and other damp spaces when you select a model designed for such environments. Built with durable, corrosion-resistant materials and engineered for reliable performance, Havells ceiling-mounted fans help improve ventilation, reduce humidity, and maintain consistent airflow, creating a more comfortable indoor environment. Their compact design makes them ideal for smaller spaces while offering quiet and efficient operation. If you're looking to buy Havells ceiling-mounted fans online, explore models that are suitable for humid conditions and check the product specifications for recommended applications. Shop from the official Havells store to enjoy genuine products, manufacturer warranty, secure online shopping, and doorstep delivery.

Why are Havells fans considered among the best fans in India?

Havells fans are among the best fans in India because they combine innovative technology, superior performance, energy efficiency, and premium design. From stylish ceiling fans to compact ventilation solutions, Havells fans are engineered with high-quality materials, powerful motors, and aerodynamic blades to deliver consistent airflow, quiet operation, and long-lasting durability. Many Havells ceiling fans also feature advanced technologies such as BLDC motors, remote controls, and smart functionality in select models for enhanced convenience and energy savings. Whether you're looking to buy Havells ceiling fans online or explore fans for every room in your home, Havells offers a wide range of reliable, stylish, and high-performance solutions backed by genuine quality, manufacturer warranty, and trusted after-sales support.

Why should I buy Havells fans online instead of offline?

Buying Havells fans online offers a convenient and hassle-free shopping experience with access to the complete range of Havells ceiling fans, table fans, pedestal fans, wall fans, and ceiling-mounted fans in one place. You can easily compare features, designs, sweep sizes, and energy-efficient models to find the fan that best suits your home or office. Shopping from the official Havells online store ensures you receive genuine products, manufacturer warranty, secure payment options, and trusted after-sales support. You can also enjoy exclusive online offers, seasonal discounts, and doorstep delivery. Whether you're looking for the best fans in India or want to buy Havells fans online, the official Havells website makes it easy to shop with confidence while accessing the latest designs and innovations.

Does Havells provide free installation for fans?

Havells offer free installation to a selected range of fans such as Stealth, Crista, Neoma, Albus, Florette.

Disclaimers 

Disclaimers of Havells BLDC Fans

1. India’s First SILENT AIRMAX*

Exclusive combination of features i.e. dual control and AC mode are currently offered for 1st time only by Havells brand in India. Claim applicable to premium (with Plastic ABS blade ) BLDC ceiling fans in 900 mm, 1200 mm, 1320 mm sweep

2. India’s First Super Hi-Speed & Ultra-Boost*

Combination of unique features, various speed options, 385 revolution per minute (Super Hi-Speed mode), 400 revolution per minute (ultra-boost mode) along with AC mode are currently offered for 1st time only by Havells brand in India. Claim applicable to select BLDC models in 1200 mm sweep” 

3.55 dB /52 dB /50 dB*

Results are based on Havells standardized internal testing conditions. Actual performance may vary depending on installation, operating, and environmental conditions.

4. Upto 65 % /  ₹ 19 00/- Savings per year*

Calculated for a 32 W BLDC Fan with 16 hours usage with ₹ 8 unit cost against a non-star rated fan of equivalent performance.

5. Remote* & Regulator / Regulator & Remote* / R&R* / Dual Control*

For complete remote-control functionality, regulator needs to be kept at maximum speed setting.

6. India’s First* Agentic AI Voice

Currently Havells is the only and first brand in India to offer combination of the features of Agentic, AI and Voice command through Havells App. Voice command, Agentic and AI can comprehend the features of fan only on the relevant prompts made and not to unrelated prompts.
